purpose: Deterministic navigation, wayfinding and end-to-end journey contract. It is presentation/interaction metadata only and cannot change evidence meaning.
semantic_authority: Production Master via current Page Specs; this contract cannot alter facts, claims, values, units, universes, periods, methods, sources, rights, evidence class or publication state.

journeys.job: Understand the strongest people-side evidence without learning the site taxonomy first.
journeys.success_condition: Plain answer precedes method depth; the verification record exposes scope, period, limitation and source.
The record makes the observation clock, population/base, limitation and original-source path visible before reuse.

journeys.job: Challenge an analytical Reading and reach the evidence it relies on.
journeys.success_condition: Reading detail provides direct links to bound Evidence Records rather than asking the user to rediscover them.

journeys.job: Decide whether two evidence objects are legitimately comparable.
journeys.success_condition: Compatibility is tested before values are compared, and selected records can be opened directly.

journeys.job: Understand how far reform evidence reaches without treating a rule as an outcome.
journeys.success_condition: Rule, implementation and outcome states remain separated and the primary verification route is explicit.

journeys.job: Inspect POS infrastructure change and verify the underlying administrative evidence.
journeys.success_condition: Terminals, transactions, value, people and use are not collapsed; source records are reachable.

journeys.persona: Bank / MFB / MFI / PSP / exchange provider
journeys.job: Understand evidenced provider status without inferring operation or national reach.
journeys.success_condition: Listing/licensing and dated status are visible while operation remains a separate evidence question.

journeys.persona: World Bank / IMF / DFI / donor analyst
journeys.job: Move from a domain answer to method and source verification.
journeys.success_condition: The same evidence object can be checked at answer, record and method depth without a second source of truth.

journeys.job: Distinguish cash-transfer delivery, remittance/macro flows and durable financial use rather than treating successful payment delivery as inclusion.
journeys.success_condition: The journey separates payment delivery from post-transfer persistence, keeps programme evidence bounded and reconnects the question to the wider payment system and source path.

journeys.persona: Any user challenging a public record
journeys.job: Report a suspected error while preserving the public record until review.
journeys.success_condition: Stable record identity and correction/report pathways remain connected; no silent change is implied.

journeys.job: Determine what may be cited, factually used or redistributed.
journeys.success_condition: Rights and reuse are discoverable from data/source work and remain separate from factual use and citation.

journeys.job: Find the accessibility position and report a problem.
journeys.success_condition: Accessibility status and the monitored report path are both discoverable without a hidden route.

journeys.job: Understand what FPS, RTGS, QR/e-wallet interconnection and YPCC mean in the current reform sequence without mistaking milestones for live adoption.
journeys.success_condition: The product explains the rail/institution roles in plain language, separates project/design/integration/institutional states from observed use, and provides a verification path.

route_deletion_test.rationale: The apparent redundancy is functional depth, not duplicate truth: indexes discover, domain pages answer, Evidence Records verify stable objects, Readings synthesize, and trust routes carry distinct public obligations. R4 removes navigation dead-ends and duplicate discovery burden rather than deleting stable verification endpoints.
route_deletion_test.evidence_record_rule: All Evidence Record routes remain addressable. Search/deep-link-only records may be intentionally non-prominent; lack of a global/static menu link is not by itself grounds for deletion because stable verification and citation value would be lost.
route_deletion_test.reading_rule: All 10 Reading detail routes remain because each is a bounded analytical object with its own thesis, evidence bindings and prohibited inference.
route_deletion_test.trust_rule: Accessibility, Contact, Corrections, Privacy, Rights and Terms remain distinct public trust jobs; they are grouped in the footer rather than hidden or merged into one legal page.
route_deletion_test.prominence_rule: Keeping a route does not mean promoting it in navigation: only six global items are primary. Evidence Records remain stable, addressable verification endpoints reached through search, Evidence, Readings or contextual links; domain and trust surfaces remain contextual.
route_deletion_test.counterfactual_result: Deleting the stable Evidence Record routes would break citation, Source Reference Closure and direct verification. Deleting domain pages would remove bounded answers. Deleting index pages would remove discovery. Deleting trust pages would remove distinct public obligations. No route family can be removed without material loss; prominence is therefore reduced instead of route identity.

accepted_lessons: Human-centered task framing is useful when it routes into controlled evidence rather than practical advice or uncontrolled calculators.
Question-first entry and progressive depth are retained; Home orients while Explore carries the complete question map.
Deep Evidence and Reading routes need explicit backtracking/verification wayfinding.
Footer links should be grouped by product, method/measurement and trust/reuse rather than behaving as an unexplained second sitemap.

Legacy citizen-journey material contributes only the idea of starting from a practical human question; all calculators, advice and factual assumptions are rejected unless replaced by controlled evidence.
rejected_or_not_promoted: No citizen-versus-expert fact mode or audience-specific source of truth.
No legacy calculators, advice, unsupported prevalence claims, old 29-route taxonomy, generic four-KPI page template or old visual identity is promoted.
No archive factual proposition changes current controlled evidence in R4.

r6_information_design_contract.first_screen_rule: Every reader-facing page must establish its job, strongest supported answer or orientation, evidence clock/scope when consequential, and the primary next action before secondary detail.

depth_model.job: What is this and where should I start?
What does the evidence currently support for this question/domain?
How should multiple evidence objects be read together without flattening differences?
What exactly is this evidence, when/for whom, and where did it come from?
What missing evidence would materially change the answer?
How is the product governed, corrected, reused and accessed?

dashboard_policy.reason: The evidence does not share one clock, unit, denominator or universe.

r6_information_design_contract.progressive_disclosure_rule: Hide density, never hide material limitations. A limitation that changes interpretation must be visible in the first meaningful evidence layer.
r6_information_design_contract.visual_rule: Use a visual only when it reduces cognitive work while preserving unit, denominator/universe, period/currentness and prohibited inference; otherwise use ordered text or a table.
r6_information_design_contract.mobile_rule: At 320–400px preserve answer, scope/clock, limitation and verification action before secondary narrative; no hover-only meaning and no horizontal page-level scroll.
r6_information_design_contract.rtl_rule: Arabic is composed natively in RTL; component order may differ from English when required for reading logic while stable objects and meanings remain invariant.

interaction_tools.label: Global bilingual search
interaction_tools.state: query in URL where practical; dialog state ephemeral
core_behaviour: query-as-you-type with deterministic local ranking
exact stable-ID match outranks title, then summary, then body text
result-type labels for page/evidence/reading/source/measurement
facets may filter by result type and domain but may not alter evidence meaning
deep-link directly to the governed object/source anchor
no-results explains that absence from search is not evidence of absence
accessibility: Ctrl/Cmd+K and / open search when not typing
dialog focus enters query and returns to opener
results are keyboard reachable and announced
no result depends on colour alone
interaction_tools.failure: If the local index fails, navigation and direct routes remain usable; show a technical-unavailable state, not an evidence-absence state.

interaction_tools.label: Evidence discovery and verification
interaction_tools.state: filters may be encoded in URL for shareable discovery state
core_behaviour: search/facet before browse-all
show evidence family, period/currentness, universe/scope and material limitation clues in result rows
open canonical Evidence Record as the verification endpoint
allow add-to-Compare only for public evidence records
never expose backend-only objects or raw governance enums

interaction_tools.label: Compatibility-first evidence comparison
interaction_tools.state: 2–4 selected evidence IDs encoded in URL query for shareable/deep-linkable comparison
core_behaviour: show compatibility/boundary rows before numeric values
compare definition, universe, geography, unit, period, method, source/currentness and limitation
state whether records are directly comparable, comparable only with qualification, or not directly comparable based on field differences; do not convert this into a truth score
provide one-click path back to each Evidence Record
forbidden: normalising to a common score without governed method

interaction_tools.label: Source locator register and curated Resource Library
interaction_tools.state: source/category filter encoded in URL where useful
core_behaviour: distinguish original evidence sources from interpretive/implementation references
filter by controlled resource_category where present
deep-link to source anchor from evidence and search
outbound links open original publisher locations
do not mirror/download third-party source files unless redistribution is explicitly permitted

interaction_tools.label: Context-preserving citation
core_behaviour: copy governed citation plus canonical route
preserve stable evidence/source identifier when relevant
do not imply CauseWay is the original publisher of third-party data

interaction_tools.label: Object-preserving Arabic/English switch
interaction_tools.state: local preference may persist; route/query/hash must be preserved
core_behaviour: switch edition without changing object, filter, comparison set or source anchor
no locale-specific fact differences

interaction_tools.label: Correction/report path
interaction_tools.state: originating record/route may be passed in URL
core_behaviour: prefill the evidence/source ID and originating route where available
static path remains usable even when no submission API exists
future submission cannot directly mutate evidence

hard_state_acceptance.must_prove: High evidence density remains scannable; survey wave/fieldwork/universe/limitation are not detached from the headline figure.
Unknown geography is visibly unknown, not rendered as zero or an empty-map implication.
FPS, RTGS, interoperability, institution-building, operation, use and outcome are visually distinct states.
Same-year revisions and observed/estimated/projected states are visually legible without selecting a winner.
Raw totals and source-displayed percentages can coexist with the discrepancy visible and the limitation prominent.
A semantic/control object with no source expected is not styled as missing evidence or an error.
The UI prevents visual pressure to compare unlike units/universes and makes the boundary the first conclusion.
All source records remain discoverable without a wall-of-links interface; the curated resource cards are visibly curated, not a separate authority.
Analytical narrative remains bounded, readable and directly traceable to verification records.
P0/P1 reads as evidence-sequencing within this agenda, never as national policy or spending priority.
Purpose, CauseWay role, limits, source authority and correction are understandable without backend terminology.
At 320–400px Arabic order, numeric/Latin isolation, tables, controls and verification path remain coherent.

must_work_without_backend: all controlled routes (one per Page Spec) in both languages
